
[[File:酉の市Torinoichi000.jpg|thumb|[[Torinoichi]]の[[Kumade]]]]
'''Washi-no-Miya Shrine''' (鷲宮神社) is the name of a [[shrine]].

It is a branch of the Ōtori faith based on [[Ōtori Taisha]], though in many cases a Washi-no-Miya Shrine serves as the head shrine of the Kantō region's [[Tori-no-Ichi]] cult – notably the one enshrined in [[Saitama Prefecture]]'s [[Kuki City]]. The Washi-no-Miya Shrine in Kuki City was the head shrine (総社) of the [[Fujiwara no Hidesato's]] {{ill|Q11444411|ja|太田荘|qid=Q11444411}}, and many branch shrines exist mainly along the [[Naka River (Saitama Tokyo)|Nakagawa]] region. In other areas, however, Washi-no-Miya Shrines are merely branches of other Ōtori faith shrines and may have no connection to the Kuki City shrine.

In addition, along the western part of the [[Arakawa River (Kantō)|Arakawa]] basin there is the [[Hikawa Shrine]], along the [[Moto-Arakawa]] basin there is the [[Kuizu Shrine]], and in the eastern and northern parts along the [[Tone River]] and [[Edo River|Edogawa River]] basins, many [[Katori Shrine]] are found. Occasionally, merged shrines such as [[Washi Katori Shrine]] or [[Katori Washi Shrine]] appear. Furthermore, since the term "宮" means "shrine," many places today label their shrines as [[Washi Shrine]] or [[Nichiwashi Shrine]], even when their old or common names remain Washi-no-Miya. For example, there is the [[Washi Shrine (Taitō)]], in Taitō Ward, Tokyo (as inscribed on its torii plaque), the [[Washi Shrine (Tsuchiura City, Higashizakicho)]], in Tsuchiura City, Ibaraki, and the [[Nichiwashi Shrine (Minamisoma City)]], in Minamisoma City, Fukushima.

As a religious corporation, there are nationwide 22 Washi-no-Miya Shrines and 2 Washi-no-Miya Associations.

See also [[Ōtori Shrine]], [[Washi Shrine]], [[Great Washi Shrine]], and [[Nichiwashi Shrine]].

== Washi-no-Miya Shrines ==

=== Fukushima Prefecture ===
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Koriyama)]] – Enshrined at Suginoiri, Yatagawa, Tamura-chō, Koriyama City.

* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Tōchigi City, Hakamori Town)]] – Enshrined at Hakamori Town, Tōchigi City.

* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Sakura City)]] – Enshrined at Washiyado, Sakura City.

* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Sano City)]] – Enshrined at Inubushi Kamimachi, Sano City.
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Shimotsuke City)]] – Enshrined at Hashimoto, Shimotsuke City.
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Moka City, Ishijima)]] – Enshrined at Ishijima, Moka City.
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Moka City, Washisu)]] – Enshrined at Washisu, Moka City.

=== Chiba Prefecture ===

* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Kuki City, 713 Shimosayami)]] – Enshrined at address 713 Shimosayami, Kuki City.

* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Kazo City, Hisashita)]] – Enshrined at Hisashita, Kazo City.
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Shiraoka City, Uenoda)]] – Enshrined at Uenoda, Shiraoka City.
* [[Washi-no-Miya Shrine (Shiraoka City, Shimonoda)]] – Enshrined at Shimonoda, Shiraoka City.

=== Yamanashi Prefecture ===

== Alternate Names, Former Names, and Merged Shrines ==

=== Fukushima Prefecture (Alternate/Former/Merged) ===
* [[Nichiwashi Shrine (Minamisoma City)]] – Enshrined at Akechi, Onaba, Kodaka District, Minamisoma City.

=== Ibaraki Prefecture (Alternate/Former/Merged) ===
* [[Sashinō Shrine (Ishioka City, Someya)]] – Enshrined at Someya, Ishioka City.
* [[Katori Washi Shrine]] – Enshrined at Komagome, Koga City.
* [[Washi Shrine (Tsuchiura City, Higashizakichō)]] – Enshrined at Higashizakichō, Tsuchiura City.
* [[Washi Shrine (Naka City)]] – Enshrined at Washi-no-Miya, Hongosu, Naka City.

=== Saitama Prefecture (Alternate/Former/Merged) ===
* [[Washi Shrine (Saitama City, Iwatsuki-ku, Sueta)]] – Enshrined at Sueta, Iwatsuki-ku, Saitama City.
* [[Aoge Gochū Shrine]] – Enshrined at Aoge, Kuki City.
* [[Shōbu Shrine]] – Enshrined at Shōbu Town, Kuki City. It enshrines as its principal deities the mother [[Kushinadahime|Inada-hime]], also known as [[Fukuroda Daimyōjin]], the child [[Takehira Tori no Mikoto|Wuyi Tori no Mikoto]], and [[Ōkuninushi|Ookuninushi]] (also known as [[Tamatsukushi Shrine|Kuizu Daimyōjin]]).
* [[Washi Katori Shrine]] – Enshrined at Uchimaki, Kasukabe City.

=== Tokyo Metropolis ===
* [[Washi Shrine (Taitō)]] – Enshrined at Senshuku, Taitō Ward.
